bytes.description: A `Tensor` of type `string`. A Tensor of string which is compressed.

compression_type.description: An optional `string`. Defaults to `""`. A scalar containing either (i) the empty string (no compression), (ii) "ZLIB", or (iii) "GZIP".
constraints: scalar containing either (i) the empty string (no compression), (ii) "ZLIB", or (iii) "GZIP"
compression_type must be one of string, ZLIB, GZIP
